scope_of_deliverables.quote: Refer to the attached Scope of Work & Functional Requirements for further information.
scope_of_deliverables.value: The City is procuring a Learning Management System (LMS) from a single legal entity; the deliverables are defined in the attached Scope of Work & Functional Requirements (Appendix D, Section A), with mandatory technical requirements in Section E. The proposal pricing form (Appendix C) indicates costs should include all licensing, implementation, configuration, training, and support necessary to meet the requirements outlined in the Scope of Work.

Other Mandatory Submission Requirements N/A

evaluation_criteria.quote: Rated Criteria Category Weighting (Points) Minimum Threshold Stage 1 Initial Evaluation Technical Capability (Appendix E) – Initial 50 35

minimum_score_threshold.quote: Proponents must achieve a minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points to meet the technical threshold.

pricing_structure.quote: Proponents should provide the information requested under section 3 below (“Required Pricing Information”) by completing the attached form and including it in their proposals.
pricing_structure.value: Pricing must be provided on the attached Proposal Form (Appendix C – Pricing, section 1(a)), included in the proposals. Rates must be in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except GST, which should be itemized separately (section 1(b)). Rates quoted must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all COVID-19 related costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law (section 1(c)). The effects (if any) of any addenda issued must be included in all pricing (section 1(d)).

insurance_requirements.quote: The Contractor shall maintain, in full force the following insurance: 2.2.1. Commercial General Liability Insurance in respect to the Services and operations of the Contractor for bodily injury and/or property damage with policy limits. Not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000.00) per occurrence with a property damage deductible not exceeding Two Thousand Five Hundred ($2,500.00) Dollars. The insurance shall include, to the satisfaction of the City: 2.2.1.1 The City of Medicine Hat as an Additional Insured; 2.2.1.2 Standard non-owned automobile liability; 2.2.1.3 Broad Form Products and Completed Operations Liability; 2.2.1.4 Cross liability; 2.2.1.5 Employer’s liability insurance with limits of liability of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000.00) per employee for each accidental injury to, or death of, an employee of the Consultant or of a sub-consultant, engaged in the Services; Or Contingent Employer’s liability 2.2.2. Professional Errors and Omissions Liability Insurance in respect to the Services with policy limits of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per claim with a 12-month maintenance period, a deductible of not more than $25,000 and with an aggregate limit of not less than $2,000,000.

value.coverage_type: Professional Errors and Omissions Liability - aggregate

data_security_requirements.quote: Security & Privacy: Ensure data security. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit to protect against unauthorized access. Single Sign On (SSO) and/or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Secure login with single sign-on or multi-factor authentication. Vendor Cybersecurity Compliance: Compliance with industry security best practices (SOC2, ISO, etc.) PIPA Compliance: Vendor server preferred within Canada to comply with PIPA. Incident Response Plan: Vendor has an incident response plan.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: The top-ranked proponents that meet the technical threshold, up to a maximum of six, may be invited to participate in Stage 2, at the City’s discretion. Stage 2 will consist of a product demonstration. Stage 2 demonstrations will be scored out of 30 points and added to the Stage 1 scores to determine the final ranking (Total = 130 points).
